variety_description: Developed in 2016 by PJTSAU, Hyderabad as a medium maturity, medium height, long slender variety for irrigated lowlands of Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Karnataka and other eastern states. Similar to MTU 1010 in grain type and maturity duration. Potential replacement of MTU-1010 in many rice growing areas. Resistant to major diseases and insect pests.  Cold tolerant. Good cooking quality grain.
